scope: Trusted-host intervention and progress checkpoints; existing worker only

limits: No UI/model workflow binding or actual GUI driver
Logical recovery and per-operation deadlines/read retry remain 7.P4b.2/7.P4b.3
Synchronous active effects must finish or yield cooperatively; no forceful cancellation
No paid provider or real user data
covered: Indefinite intervention waits release logical intake after actual child completion
Independent jobs continue; explicit Continue rejoins intake without preemption
Trusted reobservation outside locks; failure leaves wait unchanged
Revision CAS and object identity reject stale callbacks after Stop or cache eviction/recreation
Revoked authorization is still denied by normal policy after Continue
UNKNOWN from another job retains global lock and cancels pending waiting work
Three unchanged fresh observations after a baseline yield no_progress
Snapshot polling and plan corrections do not count as progress
Changed evidence and verified step completion reset counter
Observation errors/non-finite/empty state fail closed; private state stays off disk
Last actual completion and Stop/close preserve real results
